REGISTRATION_HELP_SOCIAL_NAME: Name the person asks to be called by. It is optional in EIS 820 and does not replace the legal name.
REGISTRATION_HELP_BIOLOGICAL_SEX: Biological sex coded according to EIS 820. The value set includes Not reported and Unknown.
REGISTRATION_HELP_GENDER_IDENTITY: Gender identity declared by the person. Not disclosed records that the person does not wish to report it.
REGISTRATION_HELP_NATIONALITY: Nationality coded with the EIS 820 country value set; it may differ from country of origin.
REGISTRATION_HELP_COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN: Demographic country of origin in EIS 820. It is not the issuing country of a passport or document.
REGISTRATION_HELP_BASIC_HEALTH_INSURANCE: EIS 820 health coverage category. ISAPRE identifies the category, not a specific insurer.
REGISTRATION_HELP_HEALTH_INSURER: Complete only when the coverage category is ISAPRE. Official Health Superintendency catalogue, May 2026 cut.
REGISTRATION_HELP_MOBILE_PHONE: Nine-digit national mobile number starting with 9.
REGISTRATION_HELP_FIXED_PHONE: Nine-digit national fixed number starting with a digit from 2 to 6.
REGISTRATION_HELP_OTHER_PHONE: Another nine-digit national mobile or fixed number.
REGISTRATION_HELP_OTHER_PHONE_TYPE: Relationship or context for the other phone according to the EIS 820 value set.
REGISTRATION_HELP_EMAIL: Current email address reported by the person.
REGISTRATION_HELP_PREFERRED_CONTACT_CHAN: Local operational preference; it is not consent for communications.
REGISTRATION_HELP_CONTACT_RESTRICTIONS: Current restrictions that must be respected when contacting the person.
REGISTRATION_HELP_THIRD_PARTY_SUPPORT: Need for contact or care support; it does not authorize disclosure to the third party.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_RUN: Primary RUN when available. It is normalized and validated with modulus 11 and is not required to create the BAH record.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_RUN_PROVISI: Local temporary identifier. It is not EIS code 2, which is reserved for maternal or progenitor RUN.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_BIRTH_FOLIO: Birth certificate receipt number used exceptionally when no RUN is available.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_PASSPORT: Passport used exceptionally when no RUN exists. Select the issuing country; validity dates are optional.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_ORIGIN_DOCU: Foreign identity document other than passport. Select the issuing country; validity dates are optional.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_BIRTH_CERTI: Local extension for a foreign birth certificate; it is not an EIS 820 enumerated type.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_FONASA: Provisional identifier issued by FONASA for exceptional cases without an available RUN.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_IPA: Provisional Guardian Identification. Local extension, not an EIS 820 enumerated type.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_IPE: Provisional Schoolchild Identification. Local extension, not an EIS 820 enumerated type.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_LOCAL_CHART: Record number from another facility. BAH does not request it because the BAH clinical identifier already serves that local purpose.
REGISTRATION_HELP_IDENTIFIER_OTHER: Identifier not covered by the preceding types; country, document type and issuing authority are required.
REGISTRATION_AGE_ERROR_KEY: Age should be a positive value
REGISTRATION_TELEPHONE_NUMBER_ERROR_KEY: Telephone Number should have minimum 6 digits
REGISTRATION_CASTE_TEXT_ERROR_KEY: Caste should contain only alphanumeric characters
REGISTRATION_BRING_CARD_TEXT_KEY: It is quite important to bring the card to the hospital.
REGISTRATION_TAKE_MEDICINES_TEXT_KEY: Take medicines according to instructions of the doctor.
REGISTRATION_TIMINGS_TEXT_KEY: Registration Timings are from 8:30 am to 12:00 pm.
REGISTRATION_OPD_DAYS_TEXT_KEY: OPD days are on Monday, Wednesday, Friday.
REGISTRATION_SMOKING_INJURIOUS_TEXT_KEY: Smoking, Tobacco chewing can cause cancer, heart diseases and ASTHMA.
REGISTRATION_FIRST_NAME_VALIDATION: First name should contain only alphabets without space
REGISTRATION_MIDDLE_NAME_VALIDATION: Middle name should contain only alphabets without space
REGISTRATION_LAST_NAME_VALIDATION: Last name should contain only alphabets without space
REGISTRATION_EMAIL_VALIDATION: Should be a valid email address
REGISTRATION_PHONE_NUMBER_VALIDATION: Enter 9 digits; a mobile phone must start with 9
REGISTRATION_ALTERNATE_PHONE_NUMBER_VALI: Enter 9 digits for a Chilean mobile or fixed phone
REGISTRATION_FIXED_PHONE_NUMBER_VALIDATI: Enter 9 digits; a fixed phone must start with a digit from 2 to 6
REGISTRATION_RUN_INVALID_KEY: Enter the RUN without dots, with a hyphen and a valid check digit; example 12345678-5
